name: capture-assert-api-extract-happy
description: capture binds a matching request, assertApi checks its status and body, extract pulls a value into a variable, and assertExpr consumes that variable
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: api happy path
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /api/v1/auth/login as: loginRsp"
- assertApi:
    from: loginRsp
    status: 200
    body:
      "$.status": ok
- extract:
    from: loginRsp
    values:
      userId: "$.body.user.id"
- assertExpr:
    expr: "userId == \"42\""
